title: Authority Crosswalk & Organization/Dependent Taxonomy
objective: Reconcile followers, staff, hirelings, dependents, crews, businesses, organizations, factions, settlements, households and command structures with their existing canonical owners, and define which concepts are projections or relations rather than new ledgers.

resolved_contract.crosswalk_rule: Each visible taxonomy entry carries explicit owner reference(s), owner authority id(s), representation kind, provenance and visibility evidence. ODL-01 records no owner truth of its own and never derives canonical ownership from a taxonomy label.
resolved_contract.taxonomy_rule: Follower, staff, hireling, dependent, crew, household and command-structure concepts are modeled as explicit owner-backed relations/projections unless an existing owner record is referenced. Business, organization, faction and settlement entries may reference existing owner records, but ODL-01 does not create or mutate them.
resolved_contract.owner_mapping_rule: Character-Actors owns Character identity; MIB-09 owns relationship/reputation and organization-facing relationship identities; MIB-13 remains Economy/trade authority; MIB-14 remains Base/Vehicle authority; APW-D26 remains Project authority; DPL and WCI remain their completed owner/projection authorities; Permission remains visibility/system-permission authority.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Owner mapping state is explicit as resolved, unknown, conflict or incompatible. Missing owner evidence remains unknown; conflicting explicit owner mappings remain conflict and require canonical-owner resolution. ODL-01 never resolves conflict from labels, adjacency, title or inferred similarity.
resolved_contract.permission_rule: Organizational title, rank, membership, hierarchy or command-structure position never implies system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority. ODL-01 creates no permission grant and no command execution surface.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized entries are filtered before taxonomy counts, owner counts, search text, projection summaries, provenance collections, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.provenance_rule: Only explicit provenance references supplied by visible owner-backed inputs are retained; provenance is never fabricated or inferred.
resolved_contract.capacity_rule: ODL-01 defines no follower cap, organization-size cap, capacity score, coordination load or failure threshold; those remain outside ODL-01 and ODL-02 is separately governed.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable ODL-01 persistence, duplicate organization/resource/relationship ledger or migration; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.production_scope: One read-only ODL-01 authority-crosswalk/taxonomy projection contract plus accessible nonvisual panel. No owner-domain mutation, organization management mechanics, capacity/load mechanics, command mechanics or successor semantics.
resolved_contract.validation: Activate ODL as the current validation family, add exactly one ODL-01 Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout, establish genuine RED before production, then require exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-08 and KFR remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Economy, Base/Vehicle, Project, DPL, WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.

No organization/faction/relationship/economy/base/vehicle/project/Character mutation, command authority, system permission, duplicate ledger, universal follower cap, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
ODL-02+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
